# MongoDB time-series query and index optimization — concept pack

> Time series collections store measurements in buckets; secondary indexes are built per bucket on control.min/control.max and on the metaField, so metaField cardinality, bucket unpacking with $match pushdown, 8.0 block processing, index-backed sorts on timeField and the bucket catalog's memory decide query cost. Compiled from MongoDB manual and Atlas pages plus the run's verified claims.
